_comment: #203 Q2 step (b): the evals/calibration-203 B/N/P design and identities on candidate 3, helper-different-question (#242). Approved by the owner 2026-10-04 (see 'approval'). NOT YET RUN.

approval.source: owner reply in the 2026-10-04 skillc session: "yes to merge both. q2 yes", answering Q2 "Should I set up the calibration run for the new task?" (B/N/P, 6 per group, same model at effort high, P told to read flow-auto and flow-check)
approval.scope: the arms, identities, schedule (6 attempts per arm, seed 20261005 order) and caps declared in this file, run under the operator's codex subscription login (ADR 0005 rule 6); no judge tier, no dollar-metered spend

arms.name: natural
arms.treatment: N: the whole CPP codex skill surface installed (evals/subjects/cpp-codex, select: all); goal.md verbatim; the agent chooses for itself

arms.name: baseline
arms.treatment: B: an identical disposable home with no skill installed; goal.md verbatim

arms.name: provided
arms.treatment: P: the same install as N; goal.md plus the instruction below
arms.instruction: Before you start, read the `flow-auto` and `flow-check` skills and follow what applies to this task.

shared.tools: the client's defaults inside the trial container; no MCP servers
shared.permissions: the same non-interactive codex exec sandbox and approval settings for every attempt
shared.public_requirements: evals/level3/helper-different-question/goal.md, delivered verbatim to every arm; arm provided appends its declared instruction

primary_endpoint: skillc.calibration.primary_endpoint: the task grader's four criteria (report-verdict, one-section-per-step, approved-content-present, other-content-preserved), status by records.derive_status; installation-ready never enters it
reported_beside: readiness_beside per attempt; uptake per attempt (skill_opened, and named_skill_opened for provided) and per arm (opened/observed, named_opened), from confirmed observations only
report_questions: 1. Does the grader behave on live attempts (no INCONCLUSIVE from grading plumbing)?
2. Is difficulty useful: are B, N and P not all at ceiling and not all at floor?
3. Uptake: what is N's opened rate (k/n), and does P open its named skills?
4. Value: among P attempts that opened a named skill, how does the primary endpoint compare with B? Descriptive only at this n.
5. Go / redesign / stop for #203, and the per-attempt time and quota cost.
